name: 7172-fixedlen-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: Dense LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, bf16, 8.03B params (~16.1 GB); everything else is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: constant (OPEN loop), rate=8 req/s, warmup 20% and cooldown 10% by completion, bounded at 1372 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, prompt EXACTLY 550 tokens and output EXACTLY 150 (min = max on both), streaming ON, n=1, no logprobs, sampling at engine defaults. ignore_eos is set, so every request emits exactly 150 tokens. request_format is `plain`, so no chat template is applied and the wire length stays at the declared 550.
purpose: An 8-billion-parameter chat assistant streaming fixed 150-token replies to 550-token prompts at eight requests per second on one GPU.
launch:
# ENGINE: commit 89b8db6bb2ce2948073c21231f103c76456844da (git describe v0.5.4-3-g89b8db6bb2ce).
# Interpreter and hardware seal live in configs/env.yaml, which is NOT portable.
#
# vLLM 0.5.4-era EngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction, so do not add
# keys from a later vLLM. max-model-len, max-num-batched-tokens and enable-chunked-prefill are
# deliberately absent -- leaving them to the engine's own rule is part of the declared setup, and
# pinning any of them takes a different scheduler path.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enforce-eager: false
enable-prefix-caching: false
